anyOf.description: An OCI image reference, or `scratch` for an empty base.
Another image declared in this configuration.

Base.description: The external or locally configured image used as an image's base.

FileMapping.description:
Detailed options for copying a local file or directory into an image layer.

Sources are relative to the configuration file. A directory copies its contents into `to`, a
file uses `to` as its exact destination, and trailing slashes do not alter either behavior.
Mappings are applied in list order, with later mappings replacing earlier paths.

exclude.description: Git-style glob patterns to exclude after inclusion.

follow_symlinks.description: Follow symlink targets instead of archiving symlinks. Defaults to `false`.

from.description: Local source path, optionally selected by OCI platform.

include.description: Git-style glob patterns to include, evaluated relative to the source directory.

mode.description: Portable file mode as a four-digit octal string, such as `0755`.

preserve_paths.description: Preserve the source path below the destination instead of copying only its contents.

to.description: Absolute destination path in the image.

Image.description: An OCI image assembled from a base, named layers, local files, and runtime metadata.

annotations.description: OCI annotations merged with the base image. Values here take precedence.

base.description: External OCI image reference or configured image to use as the base. Defaults to `scratch`.

command.description: Default arguments passed to the entrypoint. An empty list clears the base image's command.

entrypoint.description:
Executable and fixed arguments used when the container starts. An empty list clears the
base image's entrypoint.

env.description: Environment variables merged with the base image. Values here take precedence.

expose.description:
Ports exposed by the image in `PORT/PROTOCOL` form, such as `8080/tcp`. An empty list clears
inherited ports.

files.description: Files placed in one implicit final layer after all named layers.

flatten.description: Apply the base and added layers, then emit the complete filesystem as one layer.

labels.description: Docker-compatible image labels merged with the base image. Values here take precedence.

layers.description: Named layers to append in this order after all base-image layers.

platforms.description:
OCI platforms to build. When omitted, platforms are inferred from platform-specific files,
then default to Linux on the host CPU architecture.

squash.description: Combine all layers added by Containerless into one new layer while preserving base layers.

stop_signal.description: Signal used to stop the container, such as `SIGTERM`. An empty string clears the base value.

tags.description:
Complete image references used when publishing, such as `ghcr.io/example/app:v1`. Tags are
not inherited from local base images.

user.description:
User and optional group used to run the container, such as `65532:65532`. An empty string
clears the base image's user.

volumes.description:
Container paths intended to hold externally mounted volumes. An empty list clears inherited
volumes.

workdir.description: Working directory used when the container starts. An empty string clears the base value.

Layer.description: A reusable, ordered collection of local files that produces one OCI layer.

files.description: Files and directories to include in this layer.

anyOf.description: A value used for every output platform.
Values keyed by OCI platform, with an optional `default` fallback.

PlatformValue.description: A value shared by every platform or selected from a map keyed by OCI platform.

description: A collection of OCI images and reusable layers to build.

images.description: Images keyed by the name used on the command line and by local image bases.

layers.description: Reusable filesystem layers keyed by layer name.
